blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 34 sold over 5 months against an average of 66.2 listed, about 9.7 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was October with 14 sold. Condos and townhomes: 4 sold over 5 months against an average of 7.2 listed, about 9.0 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 3 sold.

items.t: Cedar Hills condos and townhomes for sale

blocks.text: Between Scott Road and Whalley, around 96 Avenue and 128 Street, Cedar Hills is established single-family North Surrey with planned subdivision houses. Cedar Hills Elementary and Robson Park are in the neighbourhood, with L.A. Matheson Secondary and Moffat Memorial Park just southwest on 122 Street. The Cedar Hills shops are right at the corner, so it’s an easy pick for families who want a quiet street close to City Centre.

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in Cedar Hills?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 51 houses listed with 14 sold in the month and 9 condos and townhomes listed with 0 sold in the month in Cedar Hills. Those are month-end counts and move daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Cedar Hills a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses had a sales ratio of 27%, a sellers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.
